text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. To those who've 
helped you, to friends, to special 
someone... It's a day when all kinds of 
feelings are given form as chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—...Nothing of the sort happened, and 
Valentine's Day quietly came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the next day, when I went to the 
trainer's office, Daiichi Ruby was waiting 
with what looked like a present."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: These chocolates were a gift.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, Miracle-san and Helios-san came 
to visit together, and—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: From Miracle and me, Happy Valentine's~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I just reeeally wanted to give the lady a 
present! And when I asked Miracle, she put 
crazy thought into it, right? So I was 
like, let's just give it to her together!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... we both thought really hard about 
what kind of thing would make you happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I wonder if you'll accept this...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since your feelings are so genuine, it 
would be impolite of me to decline.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Also, it is proper etiquette to express 
one's gratitude for gifts received.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I brought this return gift along because I 
wanted to hear your opinion on it, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I am ashamed to admit it, but I am rather 
ignorant of such worldly customs."
choice_data_list:
You seem used to picking out gifts, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
True, it is an everyday matter. As long as 
you don't mind me choosing based on my own 
"common" sensibilities, it shouldn't be a 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Assuming handicrafts or a silk 
handkerchief are appropriate as a return 
gift for the chocolates, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As their Trainer, you know both of their 
personalities, and you must be well 
acquainted with student circumstances too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to your continued guidance 
and support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I brought Daiichi Ruby to the 
department store. They have already 
switched over to White Day goods, and it's 
reasonably bustling.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That brand over there has quite elaborate 
packaging design.
choice_data_list: I bet Helios would like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, if it is addressed to 
Helios-san, we ought to take the 
decorative aspects into account as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san might also be interested in 
issues of that nature. Let us look into 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to Daiichi Ruby's comments, she 
clearly observes her surroundings well. It 
almost felt like my advice was 
unnecessary, but...
choice_data_list: Looks like you're ready to decide.
Looks like you're ready to decide.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, I worry these evaluation criteria 
might not be sufficient.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You both chose your gifts solely based on 
what would bring me joy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, while I can present what is 
appropriate, I know not what brings her 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I would like to receive advice from you 
with that kind of perspective.
choice_data_list: I'm happy just because you chose it, Ruby

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If that is the case, I will decide based 
on my own standards. Excuse me, I shall go 
take a look at that brand over there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking into the display case, I spot a 
bright red, heart-shaped piece of 
chocolate. It sparkles just like a 
gemstone.
choice_data_list:
(The price is... 2,000 yen for a single 
piece!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was quite an exorbitant price for 
chocolates. Yet, resting in its dedicated 
display case, the chocolate seemed to 
embody Daiichi Ruby herself—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Fo' real?! From the young lady to us?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Honmei chocolate?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This is a token of gratitude for what I 
received before.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For Ms. Helios, some fancy truffles. 
Please enjoy the variety of flavors among 
these colorful chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Truffles~~~~!! Awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady~... Thank youuu~...! I'm so 
haaaaappy~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For Miracle-san, I have prepared a 
fair-trade chocolate tablet. It is organic 
cacao, so please enjoy it with peace of 
mind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... This is such a gentle, comforting 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ruby. ...For returning my 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate chosen by Daiichi Ruby 
brought great joy to the two of them. This 
meant our objective had been thoroughly 
achieved.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be over here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the box lying on the desk and 
open it. I had bought that single 
chocolate that shone so brightly at the 
department store, wanting to give it to 
her.
choice_data_list:
I found a chocolate that looks just like 
Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list:
Of course, you don't need to give anything 
in return!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...That little crimson grain... is me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —A person of rich imagination.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, hold on a second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the box lying on the desk and 
open it. I had bought that single 
chocolate that shone so brightly at the 
department store, wanting to give it to 
her.
choice_data_list:
I found a chocolate that looks just like 
Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I am surprised.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have prepared items from the same brand 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"It's addressed to the Trainer. Please 
take a look."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I received from Daiichi Ruby was the 
exact same single red chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
After seeing it at the department store 
that day, I had it ordered.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I thought this would make a fitting token 
of gratitude for your cooperation.
choice_data_list: Then why don't you have this—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, I purchased it because it resembled 
garnet.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to live up to the saying that hard 
work bears fruit. But...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"In this case, you'd just end up swapping 
for the exact same thing."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, then very well.
